items.q: Grape like Gram positive cocci that are catalase positive and tube coagulase positive are identified as what?
items.exp: Catalase separates staphylococci from streptococci while free coagulase marks aureus among staphylococci; pigment with mannitol fermentation confirms. Epidermidis stays coagulase negative.

items.q: Vomiting starting 5 hours after cream filled sweets with no fever in several guests is best explained how?
o: Preformed staphylococcal enterotoxin needing fluids only
items.exp: Heat stable toxin preformed in food triggers rapid emesis without incubation; antibiotics never help established intoxication while rehydration suffices. Invasive organisms need longer incubation with fever.
r: Incorrect. Salmonella incubates longer with fever.
items.kp: Sweets to vomiting in hours: preformed toxin.

items.q: Febrile neonate with Nikolsky positive widespread peeling but spared mucosa most likely has what?
o: Staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome from exfoliatin
items.exp: Exfoliatin cleaves desmoglein 1 in superficial epidermis sparing mucosa (desmoglein 3 compensates); cloxacillin with fluids heals while TEN involves mucosa with drug trigger. Age under five favours scalded skin.
items.kp: Peeling neonate, clean mouth: scalded skin.

items.q: Fever with diffuse rash, desquamation and hypotension in a tampon user suggests which toxin mechanism?
o: TSST-1 superantigen driving polyclonal T cell activation
items.exp: Superantigen bridges MHC-II outside the groove firing massive cytokine release; source removal with fluids and clindamycin (toxin suppression) reverses shock. Endotoxin lacks desquamation pattern.
items.kp: Tampon plus rash plus shock: TSST.

items.q: MRSA resists the whole beta lactam class because of which mechanism?
o: mecA encoded PBP2a with closed active site
items.exp: PBP2a continues peptidoglycan crosslinking where normal PBPs are acylated; beta lactamase inhibitors never restore susceptibility except ceftaroline binding PBP2a. Detection is oxacillin screen with mecA PCR.
r: Incorrect. Porins matter in Gram negatives.

items.q: Necrotising pneumonia with haemoptysis after influenza in a young adult suggests which staphylococcal factor?
items.exp: PVL lyses leukocytes cavitating postviral lungs rapidly; vancomycin or linezolid with drainage treats while enterotoxin only vomits. Community SCCmec IV background fits.
items.kp: Post flu lung cavities: PVL strain.

items.q: Indolent fever with prosthetic valve vegetations growing biofilm forming novobiocin sensitive cocci indicates what?
o: S. epidermidis device infection needing hardware removal
items.exp: Slime shields device biofilm from antibiotics so cure needs extraction with prolonged therapy; repeated cultures confirm pathogenicity. Aureus behaves acutely destructive instead.
items.kp: Slime on hardware: pull it out.

items.q: Honeymoon cystitis in a young woman growing novobiocin resistant coagulase negative cocci is caused by what?
o: Staphylococcus saprophyticus treated as uncomplicated UTI
items.exp: Saprophyticus colonises sexually active young women ascending briefly; nitrofurantoin or fosfomycin cures while novobiocin resistance identifies. E. coli dominates overall but speciation here is classic.
r: Incorrect. E. coli is novobiocin sensitive.

items.q: Right sided endocarditis with septic pulmonary emboli in an injection drug user is classically due to what?
o: Staphylococcus aureus of the tricuspid valve
items.exp: Skin flora injected venous side seeds tricuspid with lung showers; prolonged antistaphylococcal therapy with vegetation follow up cures mostly without early surgery. Left sided viridans follows dental bacteraemia.
r: Incorrect. HACEK is fastidious left sided.
items.kp: Needle use plus lung showers: tricuspid aureus.

items.q: VRSA with vanA gene is best treated with which principle?
o: Non glycopeptide agents like linezolid or daptomycin (off lung)
items.exp: vanA remodels the drug target so dose escalation only toxifies; susceptibility guided alternatives clear while daptomycin avoids lung (surfactant bound). Combination debates suit deep foci.
